credits.text:
Physics adapted from lr-core 0.8.2 by David Lu (conundrumer), MIT. Source commit ce48ebed967d24ff4582995b31342440901f913d. Port includes Point, Stick, RepelStick, BindStick, BindJoint, DirectedChain and SolidLine equations. Scarf flutter, ClassicGrid and immutable timeline omitted. Brown friction is a demo extension. See README and LICENSE.lr-core.txt.
